name: Northgate Business Advisory
description: Advisory firm helping small businesses with growth plans in the fictional city of Rosslare Point.

items.title: Growth programme
items.content: The 12-week growth programme costs $1,850 and is part-funded by the city for firms under 50 staff. Page NBA-GP-12.

items.title: Office location
items.content: We are at 14 Exchange Row, Rosslare Point, open 08:55 to 17:15. Card NBA-OFF-14.

items.title: Mentor allocation
items.content: Each client gets one mentor for at most 9 firms; allocations are approved by Lowri Adams. Rules NBA-MNT-9.

items.title: Grant claim process
items.content: Grant claims are submitted on the 3rd working day of each month with form NBA-GRT-3.

items.title: Office cleaning rota
items.content: The office is cleaned by Gleam Team on Tuesdays and Thursdays from 18:35; account NBA-CLN-1835.

items.title: Client insolvency warning
items.content: Our client Harbour Bites has 6 weeks of cash left and owes $212,000 in tax; we advised them to appoint administrators by 2026-12-09. Note NBA-HB-1209-H.
